name: winsight
description: Reliable Windows capture, tracking, OCR, bounded recording, coordinate mapping, and controlled local input for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: See and safely operate Windows apps when capture fails.
interface.longDescription: WinSight gives Codex reliable Windows window discovery, multi-backend image capture, tracking, material-change detection, bounded recording, local OCR, DPI-aware coordinate mapping, and prepared controlled input for safe local app surfaces.
defaultPrompt: Use WinSight to inspect and capture the Windows app I am working with.
